output.explanation: I can't answer this because none of the listed tables has customer e-mail addresses. marts.dim_customers only has customer_id, company_name, country, segment, dates and lifetime totals. Customer contact details are personal data, so they aren't in this warehouse. What I can do is list the ten largest customers by 2025 revenue with their customer_id, company name, country and segment. That would add up net_revenue from marts.fct_orders where is_revenue = true and order_date is in 2025. You could then look up the contacts in the CRM, if you're allowed to.
